rows.Origin:
Bred by Christopher H. Warner (United Kingdom, before 2005).
Introduced in United Kingdom by C & K Jones in 2007 as 'Gardeners Glory'.
rows.Bloom: Light yellow. Full (26-40 petals) bloom form.
rows.Habit:
Climbing. Medium, semi-glossy foliage.

Height: 10' to 12' (305 to 365cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Disease susceptibility: disease resistant. Remove unproductive wood every third year or so.
